name: Redemption Schedule
definition: Describes the reason and terms for early partial or total redemption, amortisation or extension of an issue.

BusinessDayConvention.name: Business Day Convention
BusinessDayConvention.definition: Convention used for adjusting a date when it is not a business day.

PartyType.name: Party Type
PartyType.definition: Party type entitled to ask for the redemption.

AmountFulfilType.name: Amount Fulfil Type
AmountFulfilType.definition: Specifies if the full amount or only part of it is redeemed.

MinimumNoticeDays.name: Minimum Notice Days
MinimumNoticeDays.definition: Minimum number of notice in days that must be given by either the issuer or the holder before redemption can take place.

MaximumNoticeDays.name: Maximum Notice Days
MaximumNoticeDays.definition: Maximum number of notice in days that must be given by either the issuer or the holder before redemption can take place.

FinancialCenter.name: Financial Center
FinancialCenter.definition: Financial place  taken into account to adjust the date and time, as defined within the business day convention.

NoticePeriodType.name: Notice Period Type
NoticePeriodType.definition: Specifies the type of notice period.

PriceChangeFrequency.name: Price Change Frequency
PriceChangeFrequency.definition: Redemption or amortisation price change frequency.

PriceFrequency.name: Price Frequency
PriceFrequency.definition: Specifies the frequency of the redemption.

EffectivePeriod.name: Effective Period
EffectivePeriod.definition: Period during which the issuer or holder may give notice.

Security.name: Security
Security.definition: Security for which a redemption schedule is specified.
